title: POV: The 2 A.M. Gate (Revised)

style_bible.character: One woman, 30, warm olive skin, dark wavy shoulder-length hair, slim build, face locked to the hook reference frame.
style_bible.wardrobe: Olive bomber over a cream knit with a black carry-on at the gate, then a white hotel robe at sunrise (location change).
style_bible.setting: Empty airport gate and concourse at 2 a.m., then a sunlit hotel room against a soft cream wall with no window glass in frame.
style_bible.color_grade: Cool teal night tones with warm amber accents shifting to a bright golden sunrise, clean and premium.
style_bible.lens_and_light: 35-50mm shallow depth of field with heavy background bokeh, dim cool overhead light at night and warm off-frame sunrise side light.

scenes.description: Hook, opening mid-disruption: a medium close-up as she lowers her phone with a visibly tired exhale. Her carry-on handle and empty seat rows read 'airport gate' instantly. The departure board is only a smear of red bokeh.
scenes.camera: Medium close-up with slight handheld drift.
scenes.video_prompt: Woman, 30, dark wavy shoulder-length hair, olive bomber over cream knit: lowers her phone and exhales, visibly tired, shoulders dropping. Empty airport gate at night, seat rows behind, black carry-on handle in frame. Departure board as heavy red bokeh glow, no readable text, extreme defocus. Medium close-up, slight handheld drift. Dim cool overhead light.

scenes.description: Emotional turn: from an over-shoulder angle at a slight profile, she glances back at her phone and her cheek lifts into a clearly visible relieved smile. The phone is angled away and gives off only a dim, warm, defocused glow. In post, the editor adds a small logo bug from this shot onward.
scenes.camera: Over-shoulder in slight profile with a slow push-in.
scenes.video_prompt: Woman, 30, dark wavy shoulder-length hair, olive bomber over cream knit: glances at phone, cheek lifts into a relieved smile. Same empty night gate, seats blurred. Over-shoulder slight profile, cheek and smile visible; phone angled away, soft dim warm defocused glow, not white, no screen content. Slow push-in. Warm glow on face against cool ambient.

scenes.description: Momentum: she stands and walks off down the empty concourse pulling her carry-on, her posture visibly lighter. All signage stays fully out of focus.
scenes.camera: Low-angle tracking shot from behind on a steady gimbal.
scenes.video_prompt: Woman, 30, dark wavy shoulder-length hair, olive bomber over cream knit: walks away pulling black carry-on, posture light and relaxed. Empty night concourse, glossy floor reflecting soft lights, all signage extreme defocus, no readable text. Low-angle tracking from behind, steady gimbal. Cool ambient with warm pools of light.

scenes.description: Resolution: at sunrise in her hotel room, now in a robe, she sips her coffee and settles into a gentle closed-mouth smile. Sunlight falls from an off-frame window and no glass is visible. Clean negative space in the upper third leaves room for the end card, and this frame's warm blur becomes the end-card plate.
scenes.camera: Static medium close-up with headroom left in the upper third.
scenes.video_prompt: Woman, 30, dark wavy shoulder-length hair (location change: now white hotel robe, hotel room at sunrise): sips coffee from white mug, then gentle closed-mouth smile after sipping. Soft cream wall behind, window glass out of frame. Static medium close-up, clean negative space upper third. Warm golden sunlight from off-frame window.

end_card.headline: Because delays happen.
end_card.cta: Be covered when they do. Get NomadGuard.

sound: Low airport HVAC hum, a distant muffled PA with no words, and a tired exhale in the hook. A soft warm notification chime lands on the smile, and a minimal premium piano-and-synth pulse rises underneath. It resolves into a gentle morning bed with faint birds and a soft cup clink on the final sip.
